notes.title: Version 1.3 - Camera controls and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello

We've released an update to The King's Campaign, adding in the option to change the key bindings for camera controls and fixing a couple of bugs

The changes include:

 Added menu for binding keys for camera controls
 Fixed tech related issue with not being able to train elite Cavalry
 Fixed tech related issue with not being able to build the Belfry/Siege Tower


If there are any other fixes, changes, or improvements you would like us to make, then please let us know

notes.title: Version 1.2 - Improving playability and performance
notes.notes:
Hello

We've released the second major post-launch update to The King's Campaign, making various changes to improve playability and performance

The changes include:

 Task arrow shows for single units
 Knocked a couple of seconds off world map loading times
 Updated unit flags
 Increased amount of wood peasants can gather from trees
 Houses and palisades don't show health bars


If there are any other fixes, changes, or improvements you would like us to make, then please let us know

notes.title: Version 1.1 - Improving performance and usability
notes.notes:
Hello

We've released the first major post-launch update to The King's Campaign, making various changes to improve performance and usability, as well as fixing a few issues found during testing

The changes include:

 Improvements to unit, building and prop visuals and performance by reworking LOD (level of detail)
 Updated the Options layout to improve readability
 Fixed issue with unit level up not saving in auto-resolve battles
 AI are assigned a lower level garrison when capturing cities
 Corrected amount of tax collected when using the Collect All option
 The camera no longer centres on cities when selecting them


If there are any other fixes, changes, or improvements you would like us to make, then please let us know

notes.title: The Next Update
notes.notes:
Hello, we're here with another update. This time we're fixing a rare minor issue that could prevent some of the functionality of player owned towns and armies from working properly

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43875974/ef5138350045830b950a14cc58f835663708845a.png

Most players wouldn't have even noticed and it wasn't something that was reported, but we found it during a code review, however if you do come across any issues with the game, please report them in the Bug Report discussions so that we can try to fix them

We hope you are all enjoying the game and look forward to seeing your reviews

notes.title: Another Update
notes.notes:
Hello, we've released another small update for The King's Campaign

We've updated the initial message from the advisers when starting a new campaign to offer advice on the basics of gameplay mechanics to help players new to the game

It covers selecting cities and constructing buildings, selecting armies and training units, as well as moving armies and initiating attacks

There is a brief mention of what each of the four Advisers do

We're also signposting players towards the Guides on Steam where we've added two guides and plan to add more

Guide: The Basics
Guide: Diplomacy and Vassals

If there are any particular aspects you want us to cover with the Guides, then please let us know

notes.title: First Update
notes.notes:
Hello, we've made our first post launch update, fixing an issue with one of the languages and some of the achievements, as well as improving starting armies and garrisons

Here are the changes:
Fix for Português language option not working (thanks @digones for reporting)

Fix for achievements not unlocking correctly, namely:
- On The Go
- What Did You Say?
- It's A Bit Technical
- Where Are They?
- A Diplomatic Solution

Improved starting armies and garrisons by adding militia at no extra cost

If there are any more updates, fixes or changes you would like to see, then please let us know

notes.title: Release Date Announced
notes.notes:
Bad Logic Studios and Reverie World Studios are pleased to announce that our medieval strategy game The King's Campaign will be released on Steam on July 13th 2023.
 
The King's Campaign is an updated standalone version of the Royal Blood DLC campaign for Reverie World Studios' top-selling game, Medieval Kingdom Wars, and includes the expanded map from the game's Greater World DLC and the optional Zombie Mode from the DLC of the same name.

[previewyoutube=YHvudGsaTC8;full][/previewyoutube]

The King's Campaign combines Grand Strategy and RTS gameplay as players rule a kingdom in a campaign to conquer medieval Europe and North Africa, and must build up their cities, engage in diplomacy and command their armies to defend their realm and expand their empire.

With The King's Campaign being a separate version to Medieval Kingdom Wars, it's allowed us to updateit and add features requested by players that would have otherwise adversely affected or broken thousands of players' saved campaigns for Medieval Kingdom Wars.

Some of the updates announced so far include a re-worked Tech Tree and an improved manual saving system for campaigns, with more updates still to be announced.

Existing players of Medieval Kingdom Wars can get a similar experience, minus the updates, by purchasing the DLC which are available in a bundle. The King's Campaign is more about providing an alternative option for players new to the game.

The King's Campaign is releasing on Steam on July 13th, 2023

notes.title: Language & Font Update
notes.notes:
The King's Campaign has been translated into several languages. 

These include:
English
French
Italian
German
Spanish
Portuguese
Russian
Chinese (Simplified)

We have no immediate plans to add any more languages, however we will provide a way for players to add their own custom translation that will load into the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43875974/836483138c4d7791647fffe34f84e9bf5d5aee7d.png

We'll also provide tools to enable players to add suitable fonts and character sets in order to support more languages. This tool can be used to replace the current font to one more to your liking even without changing the translation
